question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹378 for a period of 5 years at the rate of 9% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Rate of Interest for 5 years = 9% × 5 = 45%.

So, 45% of Principal = ₹378

⇒ Principal = (378 ÷ 45) × 100

⇒ Principal = ₹840

**∴ The correct answer is ₹840.**
